name: Calendar event notifications
description: Provides a calendar event content type and cron-driven email notifications to users for appointment add/update/delete.
project_description:
The Calendar Event Notifications module allows users to add, edit, or delete events from the calendar notification page itself. This module gives the events in the calendar form and its own content type and views. It manages the colours of events based on their status (past,present,future).

 This module gives feature to send reminder emails for an upcoming event before x days of the event based on the admin configuration.

 Features 
 Send email notification on event add, edit, delete.

Upcoming event reminder notification to users.

Add new events by clicking on any date from the calendar.

Different colours of events based on their status.

 Benefits 
 No need to add content type and import views template

Easy to add events (if a user permits)

Simple Admin UI to manage mail subject, body separately for Admin and other roles

Events status can be easily identified with the colour of events

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 fullcalendar_view

datetime_range

token
